# Chameleon Pharma Consulting

> > Chameleon Pharma Consulting provides strategic market entry and expansion services for pharmaceutical, OTC, medical device, and food supplement companies entering emerging markets across Asia, Latin America, MENA, and CEE/CIS regions.

The firm specializes in regulatory guidance (EU GMP certification, food supplement registration), market analysis for consumer health products, and strategic consulting for identifying optimal product-country combinations in high-growth emerging markets. They offer webinars, attend industry conferences like CPhI Worldwide, and provide deep market insights across specific therapeutic areas including women's health, aesthetic medicine, and dermacosmetics.

## Key Topics

- Emerging Markets Expansion
- EU GMP Certification
- OTC Pharma Market Entry
- Medical Device Regulatory Strategy
- Food Supplements Registration
- Asia Market Access (China, Indonesia)
- Latin America (LATAM) Strategy
- MENA Region Opportunities
- CEE/CIS Markets
- Consumer Health Products
- Aesthetic Medicine & Dermacosmetics
- Product-Country Potential Analysis
- Pharmaceutical Conference Insights
- AI in OTC Pharma
- Women's Health Supplements
